landing.faq1Q: How can I get my business listed in the directory?
landing.faq1A: Click 'Submit Your Business' or email your details (company name, website, address, category) to mail@nordible.co. Our team will verify and list you promptly.
landing.faq2Q: Is a basic business listing free?
landing.faq2A: Yes, standard verified listings for legitimate businesses and partners are permanently free.
landing.faq3Q: Which cities and regions are covered?
landing.faq3A: We primarily cover qualified businesses in Frankfurt am Main, Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, the DACH region, and international partners.
